name: The prophecy of Mosh'aru

date.label: Original World of Warcraft Classic quest-chain scene; in-world date unknown

summary: Back in Tanaris, Yeh'kinya speaks of Hakkar and asks for the tablets of Mosh'aru. His account gives the captured spirits a place in a larger prophecy, but his motive remains his own stated explanation, not an independently confirmed account of the old god's return. The first pair of tablets is the next evidence the seeker can bring to him.
